# PerchTV 0.1.34

After a live channel reconnects, a Samsung television lines the sound up with the picture by itself.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Samsung televisions, about ten seconds after a live channel comes back from a reconnect, the television tunes it once more so the sound and the picture start together. The card reads "Resyncing… lining up the sound with the picture" while it does. Before, the sound could run a few seconds ahead of the picture until the channel was cast again. A film is not re-tuned: it picks up where it was.
- On Android TV, nothing changes for viewers: the app is built with the newer Android tools.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything in 0.1.33: the phone hears "failed" only when the television gives up, and a Samsung television stops retrying a stream that keeps freezing.
